title: Isolate changes of convention in a reusable bridge
obstacle: Two definitions express related constructions under different conventions.
procedure: Write the definitions and the proposed map between their data.
Prove the required identity with every scale, sign, ordering and domain condition explicit.
Reuse that typed identity in the main proof instead of treating conventions as definitionally equal.
verification: Compile the bridge and compare both endpoints with the stated definitions.
positive_example: Prove a conversion between two explicit coordinate conventions.
negative_example: Replace one convention by another based only on similar notation.

evidence.note: Editorially generalized guidance under this maintenance policy; no independent effectiveness result or proof acceptance is claimed.
